limitations: Only the four declared files were opened. Method was read first in full; all packet records/contextual declarations, all 269 dictionary entries and metadata, and all 68 material entries plus carrier-dependent guidance were reviewed. Repeated dictionary values were losslessly compacted for display; initially truncated displays were recovered by complete smaller recursive-delta ranges. No referenced provenance source was opened.

This is only the missing-property blind slice. No persistence values or previous blend labels were read or emitted; no source-only final properties, brands, fit, claims, directions or production actions were assessed.

Every blend weight is an estimate with low confidence. The two sole-oil estimates retain their material-reference low-confidence ceilings. Quantities, actual grades, sensory performance and normal-dose penetration remain unverified.

Exact frozen dictionary admission governs penetration. Parenthetical coconut and safflower entries are not admitted even though separate non-parenthetical entries are; candidate direct/indirect/none tags do not decide the property. O09 contains the sole explicitly admitted anchor in these records, in a supporting role.

Exact frozen flag booleans were applied without repairs or synonym expansion. Notably ROSMARINUS OFFICINALIS (ROSEMARY) LEAF OIL has essential/aromatic roles but false fragrance/scalp flags, and several parenthetical essential-oil forms are scalp-positive but fragrance-negative. Those dictionary inconsistencies/limits were preserved rather than silently amended.

O21 fragrance footnote has no primary concentration order and an admitted missing separator. Its existing positive parent fragrance rank is used; no sublist member receives an invented rank, no chemical repair is made, and the supplier term does not establish volatility.

Unassessed exact functions remain unresolved in the ledger, which deliberately prevents many auxiliary suffixes. Material-prior aliases are not borrowed from dictionary identity similarity; pomegranate and several variant botanical spellings lack a corresponding exact weight-prior alias.
Complete reviewed flag-list coverage means confidence in this dictionary-based declaration result, not analytical absence, tolerance, efficacy or application permission.
